actions.desc: Adds 4 to its AC vs. one attack that would hit it as green runes encircle the giant. To do so giant must see the attacker and can't be invisible
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Руник Шиелд»; тип: reaction. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Runic Shield

traits.desc: When it dies the runes on its body flash a bright green then turn to mundane malachite. Each creature within 20' of giant: cursed 7 days (DC 16 Con negates) or until lifted by remove curse spell or similar. While cursed creature has disadvantage on saves and on first attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Fiends have disadvantage on the save.

traits.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 2d8 fire (included in below).
